findings.title: Admin route is reachable with no auth check
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one critical security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: server.js:8
Issue: Admin route is reachable with no auth check (CWE-306, A01:2025)
What to change: Require an authenticated user before the handler runs (e.g. router-level requireAuth middleware, FastAPI Depends(get_current_user), Flask @login_required, or a session check in the Next.js route), and for admin routes also check the role. If this endpoint is intentionally public, mark the finding as ignored.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "655dd4cc1104".
